requirement: Open chat marks the message only after it has scrolled into the viewport

oracle.invariant: The build check prints a count >= 1. Each run: qa.samples is non-empty when read (else BLOCKED note fixture-session-missing). Each run: at least one pre sample has top < 0 or top >= vh, i.e. the message started outside the viewport (else BLOCKED note weak-fixture). Each run: marked has at least 1 sample. Each run: every marked sample has 0 <= top < vh, first included (before #772 the first marked sample sat at top -1780 with vh 1000 on 3/3 cold opens, QA-B03 r1; after: top 94, 49/49 samples in view, QA-B03 r2). Runs 1-3: qa.sawCover = true, qa.cover is set, first.t >= qa.cover and first.t - qa.cover <= 4000 ms. Each run: last.t - first.t <= 3000 ms (FLASH_MS 2400) and no element carries data-tracy-msg-flash when read. Runs 1-3: the final page.url() has no tracy-msg parameter and its path contains '/s/' + SESSION; run 4: the measured page's path contains '/s/' + SESSION.
oracle.productSourceGap: no deterministic run, so no code to follow; owner layer flows, needs stand, site:any, seat:owner, fixture:chat-session-with-3-later-turns

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
